game_mafia_help:
🎭 Mafia - How To Play
Mafia is a social deduction game. 1. Players join the match. 2. Secret roles are assigned. 3. Mafia secretly eliminates players at night. 4. Villagers discuss and vote during the day. 5. Villagers win by finding all mafia. 6. Mafia wins if they control the group.
game_mafia_rules:
🎭 Mafia Rules
• Minimum 5 players required. • Do not reveal private role messages. • Voting is final. • Dead players cannot vote. • Admins can stop the game if needed.
game_mafia_rewards:
🎭 Mafia Rewards
🏆 Winning Team: 100 Coins + 50 XP 🎯 Best Player: 150 Coins + 80 XP 🎮 Participation: 10 XP
game_imposter_help:
🕵️ Imposter - How To Play
One player becomes the imposter while others receive the same secret word. Players ask questions and try to find who does not know the word.
game_imposter_rules:
🕵️ Imposter Rules
• Minimum 3 players required. • Do not directly say the secret word. • Vote carefully. • Imposter wins by staying hidden.
game_imposter_rewards:
🕵️ Imposter Rewards
🏆 Winner: 80 Coins + 40 XP 🎮 Participation: 10 XP
game_truth_dare_help:
🎲 Truth & Dare - How To Play
Choose Truth or Dare and complete the challenge given by Yumeko.
game_truth_dare_rules:
🎲 Truth & Dare Rules
• Keep it fun and respectful. • No harmful tasks. • Players can skip limited times.
game_truth_dare_rewards:
🎲 Truth & Dare Rewards
🎁 Complete challenge: 20 Coins + 10 XP
game_quiz_help:
🧠 Quiz Battle - How To Play
Yumeko asks questions. The fastest correct answer gets points.
game_quiz_rules:
🧠 Quiz Rules
• Answer before time runs out. • Fastest correct answer wins the round. • No spam answers.
game_quiz_rewards:
🧠 Quiz Rewards
🏆 Winner: 60 Coins + 30 XP 🎮 Participation: 5 XP
game_word_chain_help:
🔤 Word Chain - How To Play
Each player sends a word starting with the last letter of the previous word.
game_word_chain_rules:
🔤 Word Chain Rules
• Words cannot repeat. • Must start with the correct letter. • Invalid words are rejected.
game_reaction_help:
⚡ Reaction Battle - How To Play
Tap the correct button as fast as possible when Yumeko says GO.
game_reaction_rules:
⚡ Reaction Rules
• Only first valid tap wins. • False taps may be ignored. • Fastest player gets reward.
game_typing_race_help:
⌨️ Typing Race - How To Play
Yumeko gives a sentence. Type it exactly as shown before others.
game_typing_race_rules:
⌨️ Typing Race Rules
• Text must match exactly. • First correct message wins. • Edited messages do not count.
game_daily_help:
🎁 Daily Rewards - How To Use
Use /daily once every day to claim coins and XP.
game_daily_rules:
